description: Record per-question manual grades and written grading notes for one submitted LMS assessment attempt (attempts carried across course releases grade against their exact historical form version). Grades are append-only facts; the effective grade, lesson progress, and course state update atomically. The result stays masked from the worker until it is explicitly released. Pass expectedTargetHash (from the review reviewTarget) to fail with a typed 409 REVIEW_TARGET_STALE conflict — including the current target — if a worker resubmission moved the canonical latest attempt.

expectedTargetHash.description: Optional fence: the reviewed lesson's reviewTarget.targetHash.

idempotencyKey.description: Required request idempotency key. Reuse it only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_grade_assessment
